name: Git Commit Amend
description: Amend the current HEAD through a bounded contract: exact message file, exact repository scope, and explicit expected HEAD check.

guardrail_repo.description: Path to the Guardrail checkout that contains the commit-amend wrapper

repo_path.description: Relative path to the target git repository

message_file.description: Relative path to a commit message file. File contents are content-hash bound at approval time.

expected_head.description: Required expected HEAD SHA (full or abbreviated) to prevent races

steps.description: Verify the expected HEAD and amend the current commit with the approved message file.

constraints: Only the approved repo_path and committed message_file influence execution
expected_head must match current local HEAD before amend
The wrapper updates only the current commit via --amend, no branch or flag injection
The recipe performs no push and no unrelated path reads
invariants: The recipe uses the git-commit-amend bundled wrapper
Execution requires explicit expected_head, approved message_file, and exact repo path
The wrapper fails closed when expected_head does not match the current HEAD
